Visit Kerið Crater, Geysir, Gullfoss, Brúarfoss, and Þingvellir National Park — all in one unforgettable day. Discover Iceland’s legendary Golden Circle on this full-day tour from Reykjavík, guided in Chinese! Visit waterfalls, geysers, volcanic craters, and the country’s most historic national park — all in one unforgettable day. Start your adventure at the Kerið Volcanic Crater , known for its striking red slopes and deep blue lake. Continue to the Geysir Geothermal Area , where the famous Strokkur erupts every few minutes, shooting boiling water high into the air. Nearby awaits the mighty Gullfoss Waterfall , one of Iceland’s most powerful and breathtaking natural wonders. You’ll also visit the stunning Brúarfoss , nicknamed “Iceland’s blue waterfall” for its vivid turquoise color — a true hidden gem on the route. Finish your journey at Þingvellir National Park , a UNESCO World Heritage Site where you can walk between the North American and Eurasian tectonic plates. Experience the best of Iceland’s nature and history — all with our friendly Chinese-speaking guide! What's included? Guided in Chinese. Icelandic weather is unpredictable - please dress accordingly Pick-up Service Information Pick-up service starts at 7:00 AM. Please arrive at your selected pick-up point on time and wait for the vehicle. Please note: Bus Stop #12 is the free meeting point. Pick-up and drop-off from all other locations are available for an additional fee. Pick-up times may be slightly delayed due to traffic. The maximum waiting time is 40 minutes, so please remain at your designated pick-up point. Please look for a vehicle with the "Magic Iceland Travel" logo. Cancellation Policy You will receive a full refund if you cancel by emailing info@magicicelandtravel.com at least 24 hours before departure. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before departure are non-refundable. If the tour is cancelled by the operator due to severe weather, road conditions, or other unforeseen circumstances, we will do our best to reschedule your tour, arrange an alternative activity, or provide a full refund. The tour duration is an estimate and may vary depending on weather conditions. As our Chinese-language tours include both an English-speaking driver and a Chinese-speaking guide, they require a minimum of 10 participants to operate. In the unlikely event that the group size is not reached, we will inform you at least 2 days before the tour date. If bookings are less than 19 pax, the tour may be operated on a mini-bus.
